text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: production(us-east-1) p99 tokenization latency > 2.5s for /v1/chat/stream — possible preproc bottleneck. alert_id=inc-2026-03-10-42
Oncall Bot: page sent to Alicia (oncall) and Rene (sre)
Alicia (oncall): seeing huge tail on the dashboard, p95 ~ 450ms but p99 jumps to 2.8s for streaming requests that include tool schemas. :thinking_face:
Alicia (oncall): logs show a lot of `prompt_template.render` spans stuck in CPU syscalls, queue depth on preproc-workers=82 (target 8)
Jay (eng-ml): digging — we rolled prompt-templating v2 last night (opt-in) which introduced complex schema validation and a `re.sub` loop for placeholders. suspect is expensive regex + json-mode parsing.
Dan (support): Customer A reported streaming stalls and partial responses — they see initial tokens then a 3s stall repeatedly. they've opened a ticket, marking high.
Rene (sre): can we repro on staging? patch quick metric: `preproc_cpu_ms` shows median 30ms, p99 2800ms. This only spikes when `json_mode=true` and `tool_schema` present.
Alicia (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) disable json_mode per-route 2) scale preproc-workers from 8 -> 24 3) temporary rate-limit large tool-schema requests. I'll try (1) now.
Alicia (oncall): `/api/flags/set route:/v1/chat/stream json_mode=false --env=prod --reason="p99 tokenizer spike"`
Oncall Bot: Flag set: route:/v1/chat/stream json_mode=false by Alicia (oncall)
Alicia (oncall): dashboard p99 dropping — 2.8s -> 900ms in ~45s. p95 unaffected. partial customer reports reducing.
Jay (eng-ml): posted a quick snippet of the problematic template:
```
# heavy template with nested regex placeholders
template = """
User: {{user_input}}
Tools: {{tools_list}}
Schema: {{validate_schema(payload)}}
"""
# validate_schema uses `re.sub` to inline defaults and then json.loads for schema resolution
```
Jay (eng-ml): that `validate_schema` calls `re.sub` in a loop for optional fields — O(n*m) for field count * pattern complexity. For large tool schemas (20+ fields) this becomes horrible.
Rene (sre): also seeing increased GC and sys CPU on preproc nodes, not GPU. indicates CPU-bound preproc.
Dan (support): tracked 3 customer incidents in the last 30m referencing stalls; flagged customers: cust-A (paying), cust-C (trial). informing CSMs.
Alicia (oncall): scaling preproc-workers now: `kubectl scale deployment/preproc-workers --replicas=24 -n prod`
Oncall Bot: Command accepted, scaling in progress.
Alicia (oncall): added a temporary route limiter for requests with tool_schema size > 8KB: `rlimit:add route:/v1/chat/stream tool_schema_size>8192 10r/s burst=20`
Rene (sre): good. that should lower peak. If we still see >1.5s p99 after scale, we should rollback template v2 for all routes.
Jay (eng-ml): I can ship a hotfix to template renderer to short-circuit regex for known simple patterns (fast-path). I'll open PR but may take 30-60m.
Alicia (oncall): handoff in 30m to Rene. leaving notes: disabled json_mode on stream route, scaled workers to 24, added size-based rate limit. monitor p99 and customer queue.
Rene (sre): taking over. confirm: json_mode=false on route, preproc-deployments at 24, limiter in place. will watch error budget and rollback policy.
Rene (sre): TLDR to execs: incident caused by prompt-templating v2 schema validation + json_mode parsing causing CPU-bound preproc, produced p99 streaming stalls up to 2.8s. Mitigations applied: feature-flag disable, scale, rate-limit.
Dan (support): customers notified via status page and direct emails for affected customers. ticket links: https://redwood.support/INC-2026-1834 , https://redwood.support/INC-2026-1837
Jay (eng-ml): PR opened: `fix/fast-path-template-validate` — will try to get canary out to prod-preprod first.
Rene (sre): until fix deploy, keep json_mode off for routes with tool schemas and enforce tool_schema size cap. I'll add an alert rule: `preproc_p99_by_route > 1500ms for 2m -> page oncall`
Alicia (oncall): leaving the channel. ping me if p99 goes back up. :wave:
IncidentBot: incident_inc-2026-03-10-42 status=mitigated -> monitoring (postmortem recommended)
Rene (sre): noted. starting incident doc draft and RCA skeleton. assigning to Jay for code fix and to SRE for rollout policy.
Dan (support): will follow up with customers after RCA.
Jay (eng-ml): will prioritize fast-path fix and add unit tests for large schemas. ETA 4 hours for prod-safe rollout.
Rene (sre): closing handoff — last check p99=720ms, p95=430ms, streaming error rate normal. marking incident as 'under observation'.
Alicia (oncall): thanks team. +1 for postmortem: add load tests for template renderer in CI and a perf budget for `preproc_cpu_ms` per route.
Dan (support): copying notes into support ticket threads.
IncidentBot: This thread will be archived when status=resolved.
